Formula and boundaries

Board spread = USD amount × (sell − midpoint) / sell, where midpoint = (published TT buy + published TT sell) / 2. Sender fees apply the published 0.1% formula, floor, cap and cable charge to the CNY amount at the published sell rate. Flat Global Transfer fees are added in USD. This is an arithmetic illustration from reference-only boards, not a quote, an approval or a tax conclusion.
